title: Quant / Python Developer for AI Trading Bot
description: Looking for an experienced Quant / Python Developer to build an automated AI trading bot based on SMC/ICT concepts, TradingView alerts, and broker API integration. The project includes developing the core trading logic, connecting to a broker API, and implementing alert-based execution workflows. You should be comfortable working with financial data, building reliable trading systems, and supporting ongoing improvements to the bot's performance and stability.
